fact: The sergeant directed the party toward a rubble-choked route leading out of the Traders’ Grotto.
source_quote: The sergeant directed the party toward a rubble-choked route leading out of the Traders’ Grotto
subject: sergeant's direction

fact: Blingdenstone promises to provide directions out of the Underdark once the adventurers deal with the city’s ooze problem.
source_quote: Blingdenstone would provide directions out of the Underdark once the adventurers dealt with the city’s ooze problem
subject: Blingdenstone bargain

fact: A merchant recommended the Foaming Mug for its Darklake Stout and its beds large enough for the party.
source_quote: a merchant recommended the Foaming Mug, both for its Darklake Stout and because it had some of the only beds in town large enough for the comparatively enormous adventurers
subject: Foaming Mug recommendation

fact: The Foaming Mug serves Darklake Stout and has beds large enough for the adventurers.
source_quote: recommended the Foaming Mug, both for its Darklake Stout and because it had some of the only beds in town large enough
subject: Foaming Mug

fact: The Chamber of Commerce granted the party a ten percent discount on purchases.
source_quote: The Chamber of Commerce also granted the party a ten percent discount on purchases
subject: discount offer

fact: The merchant wrote a coupon for the party when the discount offer was compared to an advertisement.
source_quote: the merchant literally wrote them a coupon
subject: coupon creation

fact: Gyrgum observed that saving the city from slimes is worth 10% off.
source_quote: Gyrgum observes, “Saving the city from slimes is worth 10% off.”
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Chief Dorbo's promise was not money but directions out of the Underdark.
source_quote: The party confirms that Dorbo’s actual promise was not money but directions out of the Underdark
subject: Chief Dorbo

fact: The Goldwhisker Warrens are a disputed area north of the Traders’ Grotto.
source_quote: The party reviews the local map and learns that the Goldwhisker Warrens lie north of the Traders’ Grotto in contested territory.
subject: Goldwhisker Warrens

fact: Blingdenstone’s authorities describe Clan Goldwhisker as wererat squatters who are not a legitimate clan.
source_quote: Blingdenstone’s authorities described Clan Goldwhisker as wererat squatters who were not even a legitimate clan
subject: Clan Goldwhisker

fact: Senni holds a more favorable view of the Goldwhiskers than the general population of Blingdenstone.
source_quote: merchants offered a more nuanced warning and noted that Senni held a more favorable view of them
subject: Senni

fact: Clan Diggermattock returned to the territory after the drow left and began to gentrify the area.
source_quote: Clan Diggermattock then returned, claimed the territory, and began to “gentrify it.”
subject: Clan Diggermattock

fact: The drow previously conquered and later abandoned the territory now disputed by gnomish clans.
source_quote: the drow conquered and later abandoned the area
subject: drow

fact: Topsy is a former wererat companion of the party, though not known to belong to Clan Goldwhisker.
source_quote: The party remembers Topsy and Turvy, their former wererat companions, though the two were not known to belong to Clan Goldwhisker.
subject: Topsy

fact: Turvy is a former wererat companion of the party, though not known to belong to Clan Goldwhisker.
source_quote: The party remembers Topsy and Turvy, their former wererat companions, though the two were not known to belong to Clan Goldwhisker.
subject: Turvy

fact: The party proposed using Glabbagool as a living bulldozer to clear the rubble.
source_quote: Rather than search for another route, the party proposed using Glabbagool as a living bulldozer
subject: bulldozer proposal

fact: Glabbagool moved into the rubble, engulfed loose stones, and released them elsewhere to clear a passage.
source_quote: He repeatedly moved into the rubble, engulfed loose stones, backed out, and released them elsewhere.
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool cleared a usable passage in about an hour.
source_quote: After about an hour, he had created a usable passage.
subject: clearing duration

fact: A deep gnome proposed hiring Glabbagool for mining operations after witnessing his work.
source_quote: His work impressed the watching deep gnomes, one of whom proposed hiring him for mining operations.
subject: mining offer

fact: Glabbagool delights in the possibility of having a job and a role in society.
source_quote: Glabbagool delighted in the possibility of having “a job and a role in society”
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool considers himself a kindred spirit to Zalthir because they are both oozes.
source_quote: He especially identified with Zalthir, whom he considered a fellow ooze and therefore a kindred spirit.
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Zalthir is an ooze and is identified by Glabbagool as a kindred spirit.
source_quote: He especially identified with Zalthir, whom he considered a fellow ooze
subject: Zalthir

fact: Zalthir reminded Glabbagool that they already need him as part of the team.
source_quote: Zalthir reminds Glabbagool, “To be fair, we already need you. You’re part of the team.”
subject: team reminder

fact: Glabbagool observes that ordinary gelatinous cubes lack the intelligence to understand the word 'gender'.
source_quote: observing that ordinary gelatinous cubes lack enough intelligence even to understand the word “gender.”
subject: Gelatinous Cubes (general)

fact: The party decided to proceed through the rubble toward the Goldwhisker side rather than the stone wall.
source_quote: The party decides to proceed through the rubble toward the Goldwhisker side rather than attempt the stone wall.
subject: route selection
